sanskrit_verse: मधुना पयसा चैव स देवांस्तर्पयेद्द्विजः । पितॄन् मधुघृताभ्यां च ऋचोऽधीते च योऽन्वहम् ॥
transliteration: madhunā payasā caiva sa devāṃs tarpayed dvijaḥ | pitṝn madhughṛtābhyāṃ ca ṛco 'dhīte ca yo 'nvaham ||
sph_interpretive_translation: A twice-born male shall satisfy the gods with honey and milk; he shall satisfy the ancestors with honey and ghee; and he shall study the Rigveda daily.

There is no punitive consequence—only a causal gap in spiritual integrity requiring rectification.
